title: Dataset Explorer
objective: Create a reusable program that summarizes an unfamiliar CSV dataset.
scenario: Create a reusable program that summarizes an unfamiliar CSV dataset. Use synthetic or authorized data and document any external dependencies.
learning_outcomes: Apply the syllabus concepts relevant to dataset explorer.
Deliver a reproducible solution with explicit acceptance criteria.
Explain a failure case, limitations and next steps.

starter_material.notes: Project scaffolding only; the course platform does not have a secure R runtime. Use local R or an approved isolated environment for execution.
starter_material.sample_prompt: Begin “Dataset Explorer” with a small, deterministic and documented dataset.

required_deliverables: Source files with a clear project structure.
Synthetic or properly authorized sample data and data-provenance notes.
Tests or explicit manual verification evidence.
A README with setup, execution mode, dependencies and limitations.
A final summary explaining design decisions and edge cases.
stretch_features: Automate a reproducibility or quality check.
Improve accessibility, observability or performance based on measured evidence.
completion_requirement: It works with more than one compatible synthetic/public dataset without rewriting the analysis code.
grading_method: Draft human-reviewed project rubric. Code is not executed by the current CodeLeaf platform; no project should be marked complete automatically from an unverified code snippet.
